'''Bettina''' is a minor character in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.

She is voiced by [[Noelle Sadler]].

==History==
===Background===
Bettina works as a [[Prostitutes|prostitute]] for [[Jizzy B]].

===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''===
Bettina is only seen during the mission [[Ice Cold Killa]], trying to get close with Jizzy while he, showing that he simply wasn't in the mood, shoves her away. After taking abuse from him, he gets ready to call some more drugs in. She then tells him they are running low on the stuff and that they need a bigger cut. After a brief confrontation with Jizzy, he pushes her away, right up against a [[Security Guard|security guard]] while saying a few nasty comments; she replies with a few nasty comments of her own, and walks off right past [[Carl Johnson|Carl]], seconds before he points a [[Silenced 9mm|gun]] towards Jizzy's head just before the [[Ice Cold Killa|big shootout]].

==Character==
===Appearance===
Bettina's appearance is based on American R&B/hip-hop singer-songwriter and rapper Dina Rae, who is most famous for being the "Track 13 Girl" (appearing on track 13 on various Eminem/D12 albums).
